title: Deathcaught
description: Adds the deathcatcher from the game ultrakill to minecraft

This mod adds the deathcatcher from the game ultrakill to minecraft!

**What is the deathcatcher and how does it work?**

Deathcatcher is a new mob (currently only spawnable using spawn egg) that has a unique ability: it will revive any mob that died in its radius! Revived mobs are slower than normal counterparts and can be differentiated from normal ones by the red outline. Revived mobs don't drop anything and spawn without any gear, but they drop experience. If the deathcatcher is killed, all revived mobs will die with it. 

This mod is highly configurable for all your wants and needs!




<details>
<summary>Can I use this mod in my own projects?</summary>

Yes, you can use this mod in any project you want as long as you credit me

</details>





All credits for deathcatcher mechanic, design and its sounds go to [Ultrakill Development Team](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1229490/ULTRAKILL/). Please go support them too ♥
